notes.title: Announcing The Gap and Martha Is Dead bundle
notes.content:
We've partnered up with [url=https://wiredproductions.com/][b]Wired Productions[/b][/url] to offer players a gripping package full of mystery and thrills.

[h1]If you already own The Gap, you can complete your set enjoying the -15% discount![/h1]

[i][b]Martha is Dead[/b][/i] is a dark first-person psychological thriller, set in 1944 Italy, that blurs the lines between reality, superstition and the tragedy of war.

As conflict intensifies between German and Allied forces, the desecrated body of a woman is found drowned… Martha!

Martha is dead, and her twin sister Giulia, the young daughter of a German soldier, must alone deal with the acute trauma of loss and the fallout from her murder. The hunt for the truth is shrouded by mysterious folklore and the extreme horror of war that draws ever closer.

What will prevail?

notes.title: The first patch is up!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, the first patch for The Gap is here! 

First and foremost - we've got the coveted green checkmark and we're now [b]officially SteamDeck Verified[/b]!

Below is the full list of changes: 
[list]
[*] The Gap is now Steam Deck verified!
[*] Added Polish localization. Cześć!
[*] Typo/localization fixes
[*] Added VSync and more max frame rate options
[*] Fixed bugs when reentering solved memories
[*] Made the trigger for quantum computer thoughts larger
[*] Fixed Blake dialogue playing when selecting the wrong part
[*] Various visual tweaks
[*] Fixed a few reflection bugs with Raytracing enabled
[*] Various smaller bug fixes
[/list]

Thanks to everyone that reported the bugs, and if you find anything new you can post it on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1458300/discussions/]Community[/url] page or on our [url=https://discord.gg/FZcwXTc]Discord[/url].

notes.title: The Gap blew everyone's expectations! Even ours!
notes.content:
Firstly, we'd like to thank everyone for playing, following and watching [i]The Gap[/i]! This launch would not have been possible without your support :).

Reading through all of the reviews has been so heartwarming, this is much more than what we hoped for! If you've played [i]The Gap[/i] and you'd like to share your experiences - [b]please do leave a review, each of these helps with Steam visibility[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39015180/aa54ae3b1ce96bdbc767c1eedabe6c541afdd23f.png[/img]

We're extremely proud of the reviews we've gathered, both by the press...

[url=https://www.thexboxhub.com/the-gap-review/]The Xbox Hub[/url] - [b]9/10[/b][h3][i]The Gap is a lovely, thoughtful game that has a fascinating story. Travelling through various memories and timelines is brilliant and never feels dull. [...] The Gap is a game that I loved and I think you might do too.[/i][/h3] 

[url=https://rectifygaming.com/review-the-gap/]Rectify Gaming[/url] - [b]10/10[/b]
[h3][i]The Gap is a testament to the power of interactive storytelling, offering players a unique opportunity to explore the intricacies of memory, emotion, and the human psyche.[/i][/h3]


... and you - the players!

[url=https://imgur.com/a/ZA0my6H][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39015180/a7b21e3b0692aca956c1ffcf187c170b19cef85d.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=https://www.gamespew.com/2023/10/the-gap-review/]Gamespew[/url] - [b]8/10[/b]
[h3][i]This is a clever and engaging thriller, brought to life with believable characters and a very grounded approach to science fiction.[/i][/h3]


If you feel like you haven't had enough of this game yet though, or are still torn on if you should try it (You should!) then you can follow us on the platform we're the most active on - [url=https://twitter.com/TheGapGame]Twitter[/url]! 
But don't worry - we're not going anywhere yet! We're still planning to patch some minor bugs and help you if there's any issues. Just @ us!

Cheers!

notes.title: The Gap's first previews have finally released + new trailer soon!
notes.content:
Welcome to the first community post for The Gap, we've got some BIG news!
Earlier this year we've given reviewers a hands on experience with our game. Those previews have just released and we're oh so happy with the results.

[i]"It’s seriously clever stuff, and I’m excited to get stuck in when The Gap releases in full."[/i]
- [url=https://www.godisageek.com/2023/08/the-gap-is-looking-to-tackle-some-serious-subject-matter-is-a-creative-way-hands-on-preview/]Godisageek [/url]

Everyone's excited to try the full game once it's out and so are we! That's why we bring the second, big news - We'll be releasing a full, gameplay trailer at the [url=https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow]Future Games Show[/url] on the 23rd! 

[previewyoutube=AHOu84ENFeo;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]"Blending reality into a dreamlike state isn’t easy. However, The Gap does a fantastic job." [/i]
- [url=https://moviesgamesandtech.com/2023/08/10/preview-the-gap/]Movies Games And Tech[/url] 

You'll also be able to find our booth at [url=https://www.gamescom.global]Gamescom[/url] if you wanna pay us a visit, that'll be on the same day. You'll get to watch our trailer live and get to play a Demo!

[i]"We’re fascinated to journey further into the maze, and find out what answers await us at the end of it."[/i]
- [url=https://whynowgaming.com/the-gap-hands-on-preview-an-intriguingly-complex-memory-maze/]Whynow Gaming [/url]

We're really happy with this project and can't wait to share it with all of you. See you soon!
